sloka: क्षत्रियो अहम् दशरथो न अहम् पुत्रः महात्मनः ।सज्जन अवमतम् दुह्खम् इदम् प्राप्तम् स्व कर्मजम् ॥२-६४-१३॥
transliteration: kṣatriyo aham daśaratho na aham putraḥ mahātmanaḥ ।sajjana avamatam duhkham idam prāptam sva karmajam ॥2-64-13॥

translations.english: O magnanimous sage I am a kshatriya known as Dasaratha. I am not your son. A pathetic incident has been caused by my own action, condemnable by the virtuous.
